Hi [Name], thanks for your purchase! If you have any questions or need help setting up your mouse, we’re here to help. If you’d like to share your experience, you can do so via your Amazon orders page—your feedback helps us improve.
How to Respond to Real Reviews (Positive & Negative)
Positive review reply:
Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad you’re enjoying the mouse—especially the [specific feature they mentioned]. If you ever need assistance, feel free to reach out.
Neutral review reply:
Thanks for your honest feedback. We appreciate your thoughts on [issue]. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, please contact us—we’d love to help.
Negative review reply:
We’re sorry to hear about your experience. This isn’t the standard we aim for. Please reach out to us at [support email], and we’ll make it right with a replacement or solution as quickly as possible.
Extra Tips
Early reviews matter most—focus on your first 20–30 customers.
Monitor common complaints and fix them fast (e.g., connectivity, DPI settings, battery life).
